answer: The seed names one asset from a rotating six-coin basket; each identity burns 60% of the median epoch payout in it before its answer enters grading, with no refund on failure. The basket rotates weekly, so a farm cannot stockpile one cheap token, and burns traced to a shared funder void the downstream set. A thousand templated attempts cost $900 an epoch for rewards the jury mostly refuses; one honest miner spends $0.90. At close the ledger reads the pulse of that burn pool, an oasis filled only by burns and slashes, so a harbor of idle boats pays berth on every hull and lands nothing.
